data.body: CHECKPOINT 3/6: Implemented plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch-set.sh (chmod +x). Script sources ticket-lib.sh, uses _scratch_resolve_and_validate for path/charset validation, builds ISO 8601 ts envelope, uses _scratch_atomic_write for crash-safe write. DSO_TEST_CRASH=1 hook for crash-safety testing. All 25 assertions GREEN in test-scratch-set.sh. Existing test-scratch-lib.sh still 39/39 passing. Manual smoke test: bash ticket-scratch-set.sh test-id foo hello → {status:ok} + file with {ts,value} envelope.
